hooks.command: if command -v to11 >/dev/null 2>&1; then to11 code --claude-session-start-hook; else echo "The to11 CLI is not installed, so to11 skills cannot be refreshed. The /to11:install-cli skill installs it."; fi
if command -v to11 >/dev/null 2>&1; then to11 code --claude-prompt-submit-hook; fi
if command -v to11 >/dev/null 2>&1; then to11 code --claude-command-expand-hook; fi
if command -v to11 >/dev/null 2>&1; then to11 code --claude-skill-invoke-hook; fi
